title: 8BitDo controller description v1
description: One file per controller model, at crates/controller-core/controllers/<model>/description.json. The loader also checks what this schema cannot: button ids are unique, every button has a label for exactly the listed modes, every config port names a listed mode, every limit has min <= max, no button sets can_start_macro or can_be_in_macro_step when macro_slot_count is 0, at least one button sets each when macro_slot_count is above 0, and no extra output reuses a button id, 'disabled' or 'unrecognised', an extra output's buttons are remappable buttons, glide_step_ms and triggers_per_macro are above 0, a lock's packets run forward in time and its locked USB id is no config port, view ids are unique, and every view's SVG is embedded. Each view SVG declares viewBox="0 0 <width> <height>", paints only in #000000, #ffffff or none (in a fill or stroke attribute, or in style), uses only svg, g, defs, path, circle, rect and ellipse elements, and has no class or transform attribute. The loader skips title and metadata elements and Inkscape and Sodipodi elements with everything inside them. A path, circle or rect with a data-button="<button id>" attribute is that button's hotspot: it must lie inside the viewBox, name a listed button, and appear at most once per view. Every button needs a hotspot in at least one view. How to draw a view: docs/controller-views.md.

short_name.description: Short model name for tight places, such as the controller picker.

model_ids.description: Model ids the START_CONFIG reply carries. Empty for a model that its config ports name: it gets no START_CONFIG, and no other description may list any of its config port USB ids.

config_ports.description: The config interface of every current mode, one per USB id.

profile_rename.description: Optional, true when omitted. False when the controller keeps its profile names as they are, so the editor offers no rename.

macro_sticks.description: Optional, analog when omitted. What a macro step stores of each stick. analog: any x and y from 0 to 255. directions8: the centre or one of 8 directions at full deflection.

limits.description: Name lengths and the macro limits the editor offers. They must fit the profile and macro schemas and the model's codec. The ranges of settings sit on each setting. Omit an optional limit when the controller lacks that feature: the editor hides it and a macro file that uses it is refused.

macro_name_length.description: Optional. Omit it when a macro has no name.

macro_steps.description: Steps in one macro, as the pad stores them, after glides become short steps.

macro_step_ms.description: Length of one macro step in milliseconds.

macro_repeat_count.description: Optional. Plays per trigger press. The editor also offers continuous, which plays until the next press. Omit it when a macro plays once per press.

macro_interval_ms.description: Optional. Pause between two plays in milliseconds. Omit it when a macro has no pause.

glide_step_ms.description: Optional. Length of each short step a stick or trigger glide becomes on write, in milliseconds. Omit it when a macro step cannot glide.

triggers_per_macro.description: Optional. The most trigger buttons one macro takes. Omit it for no limit.

settings.description: The settings tabs, in display order, after the Buttons tab.

views.description: Drawings of the controller, in display order.

FirmwareVersion.description: The oldest firmware that has this item, as the pad reports it: a major number, a point and two digits, such as 1.03. The editor shows the item only when the controller's firmware is that version or later, and hides it when the firmware is unknown. Omit it for every firmware.

Lock.description: Optional. A controller that hides its config port until it gets an unlock sequence. Omit it when the config port always shows.

locked.description: The controller while it is locked. Another pad may share the USB id, so the product string must match too.

unlock.description: The sequence that shows the config port: written to an interrupt OUT endpoint of the locked controller's USB interface. The unlock worked when a config port shows on the same USB port within timeout_ms of the last packet.

endpoint.description: The interrupt OUT endpoint address, such as 0x02.

relock.description: The sequence that returns the controller to its locked mode: written to the config port as output reports, each zero padded to 64 bytes.

TimedPackets.description: Packets in send order. at_ms counts from the first packet of the sequence and never goes down.

data.description: 1 to 64 bytes in hex without spaces, such as 0008000100000000.

ModeId.description: A mode's id, such as xinput. Each model names its own modes.

interface.description: USB interface number whose hidraw node carries the config reports.

framing.description: plain: report 0x81 out, 0x02 in. wrapped: Nintendo-id framing with an 01 66 AA prefix. length: older pads such as the Pro 2, with a length byte after the 0x81 and plain replies.

write_via.description: Optional. The mode to flip the controller to before a write, when this mode takes no writes in place. That mode needs a port of its own without write_via.

needs_keepalive.description: Optional, false when omitted. True when the controller resets and reconnects in this mode while no program holds its event node open. 8B then offers a udev rule that matches this USB id and starts a unit to hold the node.

match_vendor.description: Optional, false when omitted. True when the udev access rule may match every hidraw node of this USB vendor, because the vendor makes nothing but game controllers. Otherwise the rule matches this vendor and product only.

label.description: Name shown to the user, such as XInput.

trigger_kind.description: How the triggers read in this mode, and so in a macro step. analog: a pressure from 0 to 255. on_off: pressed or released.

macro_stick_floor.description: Optional. The lowest dead zone low end, in percent, at which a macro still moves a stick in this mode, read from each slider with a macro_stick. Omit it when every low end plays.

gamepad_mode.description: Optional. The byte the pad stores in a profile image, and selects the mode by. Unique per model.

extra_outputs.description: Outputs beyond the buttons and 'disabled', which every mode has. An output a mode does not list is not offered in that mode.

buttons.description: Optional. The remappable buttons that may take this output in this mode. Omit it for every remappable button.

hint.description: Optional. How to use this output on the pad, shown beside a button that has it.

leaving_hint.description: Optional. A warning shown when a button the controller holds on this output is set to another one.

code.description: Optional. The code a button map entry holds for this output, such as 0x400000.

SettingsPage.description: One settings tab. Each value is named by a JSON pointer into the profile, such as /sticks/left_min_pct. Two tabs may share an id when their modes differ.

modes.description: The modes that show this tab. Omit it for every mode.

Slider.description: One number, or the two ends of a range when high is set. unit follows the value, such as %; without one the value shows as <value> of <max>.

macro_stick.description: Optional, on a stick's dead zone slider. The macro stick whose moves stop playing when low is under the mode's macro_stick_floor.

labels.description: Optional. A name for each value from min to max, in order, such as Off, Pulse and Wave for a choice. The app shows the name instead of the number.

Flag.description: One on-or-off setting. excludes lists the flags of the same mode that may not be on together with it.

id.description: Canonical position name, as in button_mappings.source and .target. Never shown.

labels.description: Name shown to the user, one per listed mode.

printed_label.description: Optional. The name printed on the physical button, the same in every mode. Set it only when the print differs from labels: the button column, the views and the macro editor then show it, and labels keeps naming the output in each mode.

spoken_labels.description: What a screen reader says for a label that is a symbol, such as Minus for − or Up arrow for ↑. Sparse: a listed mode without an entry is read from its label. The loader rejects a mode the button has no label in.

can_be_remapped.description: A button mapping may give this button an output other than its own press.

can_be_output.description: This button's press may be the output of another button.

can_start_macro.description: Pressing this button may start a macro (a macro trigger button). The same in every mode. Default false.

can_be_in_macro_step.description: This button's press and release may appear in a macro step (a step button). The same in every mode. Default false.

step_trigger_value.description: A macro step holds this button's press in its left or right trigger value, as a pressure in an analog mode, not among its pressed buttons. At most one button per side, and it sets can_be_in_macro_step. Absent for a plain button.

map_index.description: Optional. Where this button's entry sits in the pad's button map. Unique per model.

map_codes.description: Optional. The code a button map entry holds when it sends this button's press, one per listed mode. A mode without an entry has no such output. The same code can mean another button in another mode.

macro_code.description: Optional. The code a macro record holds for this button, the same in every mode. Set it on its own: it is not taken from map_codes.

id.description: View name, unique within the description. Never shown.

label.description: The caption the editor draws over the view, in sentence case, such as "Front" or "Back".

svg.description: File name of the SVG, next to description.json. Line art in #000000 on #ffffff, which the UI swaps per theme. Button shapes carry data-button attributes.
